caveats: Region covered by 60x60 cells of the dataset's 0.02-deg grid (lat 57.58-58.76 N, lon 10.26-11.44 E; requested bounds fall between grid points, so nearest grid cells were included). 296 of 3600 region cells have no SST on any target day (and none in the baseline either; land/no-data) and are set to 0; the remaining 3304 sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days) were used. Thresholds/climatology from 1992-2002 baseline pools of +/-5 calendar days (extending to 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05), day 60 = mean of days 59/61, then 31-day centred circular smoothing; per-cell MHWs: >=5 consecutive days with SST(kelvin) >= smoothed day-of-year threshold, gaps of <=2 days merged. One regional event was found: 2004-08-05 to 2004-08-15 (all 2356 MHW cells active 2004-08-10/11).
